title: [E16-08] Backups, Restore Drills and Operational Observability
body:
<!-- nasj-backlog:E16-08 -->

**Parent epic:** https://github.com/wie-challenge/website/issues/17

**User Story:**
As a engineer, I want to add backups, restore drills and observability, so I can operate reliably.

**Epic:** E16 — Architecture, security, tests, deployment & operations  
**Domain:** Infrastructure / Security / QA  
**Type:** Infrastructure  
**Priority:** P1  
**Target Release:** C — Controlled pilot — after operational gates  
**Estimated Hours:** TBD — team estimate required  
**Story Points:** 5 — provisional source estimate  
**Sprint / Day:** Unscheduled  
**Assignee:** Unassigned  
**Owner Role:** Engineering/QA  
**Status:** Proposed  
**Source PDF Mapping:** Expanded product scope; no PDF story mapping  
**Suggested Labels:** `story`, `P1`, `release:C`, `epic:E16`, `infrastructure`, `security`, `qa`

**Dependencies:** [E16-11](https://github.com/wie-challenge/website/issues/30)
**Dependency Provenance:** Source blockers: —; additional proposed blockers: E16-11.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

- [ ] Recovery target, log redaction and alert tests documented.
- [ ] Define reviewed recovery-time/recovery-point targets and backup ownership.
- [ ] Produce protected backups and execute a restore into an isolated environment.
- [ ] Capture structured redacted logs, health checks and actionable alerts.
- [ ] Document incident/rollback procedures and verify restored ledger consistency.

**Technical Notes / Deliverables:**

Cover PostgreSQL and required private documents/configuration; backup storage follows reviewed access and retention rules.

**Verification / Evidence:**

Perform restore drill, compare reconciled balances and trigger an alert; attach actual times rather than assumed target compliance.

**Completion Rule:** Attach evidence for all criteria and complete review. Verify applicable permissions, failure states and business invariants. Label synthetic results; individual wearable data never enters commerce.
